object: mathematical lessons from the R2 coordinate inventory and bounded C034-C040 fractional sibling evidence

experiences.typed_mathematical_statement_or_failure: Q(A,B)<=f(m) and Q(A_N,B_N)>=g(N) imply only m>=f^{-1}(g(N)); the root-facing gate additionally requires f^{-1}(g(N))=omega(log N).

broken_assumptions: A lower bound Q=omega(log N) was treated as sufficient without composing with f^{-1}.

experiences.falsifier_or_next_discriminator: Write f and g explicitly per row and calculate f^{-1}(g(N)) before retaining the coordinate.
non_guarantees: Does not prove that no useful coordinate exists.

framework_feedback.lesson: RAKL mathematical-application feedback should admit typed mathematical operations, failures, scope, polarity and falsifiers while routing operational assurance to a separate ledger.
framework_feedback.reason: Current RAKL v3 and the existing mathematical-experience boundary already encode this separation; this round supplies application evidence, not fresh assurance for a framework change.
